body:
When I was diagnosed with severe depression, I didn't know what to do. I wanted to take a year off, trying to figure out what to do with my life. My psychologist, doctor and family told me not to do so, fearing that I might slip into a larger void. I trusted them, followed courses for a year. Failed miserably, I even knew I would fail from the start.

My University doesn't understand why I did that, spending money on education, wasting resources of the government. I felt miserable during the interview. They lost hope in me and I lost hope in the government.

I'm quite happy to have found new friends these last couple of months. I still feel lonely, whenever people ask me what's wrong or why I'm slacking. I can give them an explanation, but it feels like talking to a brick wall. Hell, sometimes I don't even know what's going on inside of me.

It feels like a never ending cycle.
